question: The perimeters of two similar triangles ΔRST and ΔABC are 26 cm and 39 cm, respectively. If AB = 24 cm, then RS is __.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For similar triangles, the ratio of corresponding sides is equal to the ratio of their perimeters.

⇒ RS ÷ AB = Perimeter of ΔRST ÷ Perimeter of ΔABC

⇒ RS ÷ 24 = 26 ÷ 39

⇒ RS ÷ 24 = 2 ÷ 3

⇒ RS = 16 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 16 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Formula Used:**

For two similar triangles, the ratio of their perimeters is strictly equal to the ratio of their corresponding sides.

⇒ If ΔRST ∼ ΔABC, then Perimeter(ΔRST) ÷ Perimeter(ΔABC) = RS ÷ AB

**Calculations:**

⇒ 26 ÷ 39 = RS ÷ 24

⇒ 2 ÷ 3 = RS ÷ 24

⇒ RS = (2 × 24) ÷ 3

⇒ RS = 48 ÷ 3

⇒ RS = 16 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 16 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio of Areas of Similar Triangles

The ratio of the areas of two similar triangles is equal to the square of the ratio of their corresponding sides. Area(Δ1) ÷ Area(Δ2) = (Side1 ÷ Side2)².

Ratio of Perimeters of Similar Triangles

The ratio of perimeters is exactly equal to the ratio of corresponding sides, altitudes, or medians. P1 ÷ P2 = S1 ÷ S2.

Congruence vs Similarity

Congruent triangles are identical in both shape and size (ratio 1:1), whereas similar triangles have the same shape but are proportionally scaled relative to each other.
